description: Gamma function gamma(x) for real x

tolerance.reason: gamma(x) grows like ((x + g - 1/2)/e)^(x - 1/2); rounding the base to a double is amplified by the exponent, up to 171 * 2^-53 (about 2e-14) at the overflow edge x = 171.6, and by the same amount through the reflection formula for negative x; 1e-13 allows that plus a few ulps of further arithmetic

grid: x = -30..180 step 0.25 (poles at 0, -1, ..., -30; overflow above about 171.62), plus +-10^k for k = -300..-10 step 10
